# Wishlist Safari

> Wishlist Safari helps travellers plan an African safari around the wildlife they most want to see. Visitors choose species (for example lion, leopard, mountain gorilla, shoebill, brown hyena, pangolin, Pel's fishing owl, black rhino), and Wishlist Safari matches them to the regions and independent, often community-led, camps where those species are reliably seen. Wishlist Safari then introduces the traveller directly to the camps' own reservations teams, who quote and book as normal. Coverage: South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe and Zambia, with more countries listed in the planner.

## Species guides
- [Where to see lions in Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/lion.html): Masai Mara and Serengeti, Okavango, Greater Kruger, Busanga Plains; best June to October.
- [Where to see leopards in Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/leopard.html): Sabi Sand, South Luangwa, Okavango; best May to October.
- [Where to see elephants in Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/elephant.html): northern Botswana, Hwange, Mana Pools, South Luangwa, Greater Kruger; best July to October.
- [Where to see mountain gorillas](https://wishlistsafari.com/mountain-gorilla.html): Volcanoes NP (Rwanda), Bwindi and Mgahinga (Uganda); permits about US$800 to $1,500.
- [Where to see cheetahs in southern Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/cheetah.html): Kgalagadi, Etosha region, Busanga Plains.
- [Where to see African wild dogs](https://wishlistsafari.com/african-wild-dog.html): northern Botswana, Hwange, Mana Pools; best June to September (denning).
- [Where to see black rhino in Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/black-rhino.html): Namibia's Damaraland and Etosha region.
- [Where to see a shoebill](https://wishlistsafari.com/shoebill.html): Bangweulu Wetlands (Zambia, May to July), Mabamba Swamp and Murchison Falls (Uganda), Akagera.
- [Where to see Pel's fishing owl](https://wishlistsafari.com/pels-fishing-owl.html): Okavango Panhandle, Pafuri, South Luangwa, Liwonde.
- [Where to see brown hyena in Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/brown-hyena.html): Makgadikgadi, Kalahari, Madikwe, Namib coast.
- [Where to see a pangolin on safari](https://wishlistsafari.com/pangolin.html): southern Kalahari, May to August.
- [Where to see an aardvark on safari](https://wishlistsafari.com/aardvark.html): southern Kalahari, the Karoo, Makgadikgadi; best June to August.
- [Where to see black-maned Kalahari lions](https://wishlistsafari.com/black-maned-kalahari-lion.html): Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park; best March to May.
- [Where to see desert-adapted elephants](https://wishlistsafari.com/desert-adapted-elephant.html): Hoanib and Huab valleys, Damaraland and Kunene, Namibia; best May to October.
- [Where to see meerkats in the wild](https://wishlistsafari.com/meerkat.html): Makgadikgadi and the southern Kalahari; habituated colonies at dawn.
- [Where to see chimpanzees in Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/chimpanzee.html): Kibale (Uganda) and Nyungwe (Rwanda); Kibale permits about US$250 in 2026.
- [Where to see great white sharks in South Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/great-white-shark.html): Gansbaai and Mossel Bay; less reliable since orcas arrived around 2017.
- [Where to see southern ground hornbills](https://wishlistsafari.com/southern-ground-hornbill.html): Greater Kruger, Pafuri, South Luangwa, Kafue, Hwange, Mana Pools.
- [Where to see the African broadbill](https://wishlistsafari.com/african-broadbill.html): northern KwaZulu-Natal and Zimbabwe's Honde Valley; display season October to January.
- [Where to swim with whale sharks in Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/whale-shark.html): Tofo, Mozambique; best October to March.
- [Where to see humpback whales in southern Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/humpback-whale.html): KwaZulu-Natal, Tofo and the Cape coast; June to November.
- [Where to see nesting sea turtles in South Africa](https://wishlistsafari.com/nesting-turtles.html): northern KwaZulu-Natal; nesting November to January, hatchlings January to March.

## Key pages
- [Plan by species](https://wishlistsafari.com/): the wishlist planner and enquiry form.

## Notes
- Wildlife locations are given at regional level only; no live or precise locations, and none for rhino or pangolin.
- Contact: hello@wishlistsafari.com
